M-TEXT-FIELD-WIDGET.Purpose: Single-line controlled text editor preserving native IMGUI keyboard, selection, caret and IME behavior with validated proposed value callbacks.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: TextField Value, MaxLength, Validator, OnValueChange, Placeholder, Disabled and native focus/submit/cancel hooks.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Font, TextAlign, Color, Tooltip and DrawTextFieldBackground native surface toggle.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Focus registry implementation — owned by M-FOCUS-MANAGER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Value is owner-authoritative; GUI.TextField proposes text. Non-identical proposals reach OnValueChange only when enabled and allowed by Validator, without assigning Value.
Requirements.REQ-002: Validator vetoes proposed edits; an externally supplied invalid Value remains visible and receives invalid text tint.
Requirements.REQ-003: Placeholder never enters Value and draws only while empty and unfocused.
Requirements.REQ-004: Native GUI.TextField retains focus, caret, selection and IME. DrawTextFieldBackground false suppresses native backgrounds on a private GUIStyle copy without modifying the shared style.
Requirements.REQ-005: Disabled suppresses editing, submit and cancel; a focused field loses native focus when it becomes disabled.
Requirements.REQ-006: Intrinsic text-field size is 100 by 30 UI units, limited by supplied MeasureMode; font/alignment and native GUI state are restored after rendering.

Inputs.IN-001: Value, edit and native presentation Props, and native mouse/keyboard input.

Outputs.OUT-001: Optional validated proposed string through OnValueChange; OnSubmit/OnCancel actions.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Native GUI.TextField editing, focus registration and conditional callback invocations.
